items.title: Irrigation’s climate benefit could equal 363 years of its own emissions
items.title_en: Irrigation’s climate benefit could equal 363 years of its own emissions
items.title_zh: 灌溉带来的气候效益可能相当于其自身363年的排放量
items.summary_en: U.S. irrigation produces some greenhouse gas emissions, but new research suggests it prevents vastly more by allowing farmers to grow more food on less land. Without irrigation, replacing lost crop yields could require converting natural ecosystems into farmland, releasing an estimated 6.86 gigatons of greenhouse gases. That is equivalent to about 363 years of current annual U.S. irrigation emissions.
items.summary_zh: 美国的灌溉会产生一定量的温室气体排放，但最新研究表明，通过让农民在更少的土地上种植更多粮食，灌溉实际上防止了数量远超其排放量的温室气体排放。 如果没有灌溉，为了弥补作物减产造成的损失，可能需要将自然生态系统转化为农田，据估计这将释放6.86吉吨的温室气体。这相当于美国当前灌溉年排放量的约363年。

items.title: East Asian heatwaves intensify faster than they dissipate in a warming climate
items.title_en: East Asian heatwaves intensify faster than they dissipate in a warming climate
items.title_zh: 在气候变暖的背景下，东亚地区的热浪加剧速度快于其消退速度
items.summary_en: Extreme heat research has primarily emphasized static characteristics, while the temporal evolution of heatwaves remains less explored. Using observations (1979–2024) and CMIP6 simulations, we quantify heatwave lifecycle dynamics across East Asia in terms of onset and decay rates. Heatwaves consistently intensify faster than they dissipate, with stronger asymmetry at higher latitudes. Future changes depend strongly on how extremes are defined. Under a fixed-baseline framework, both onset and decay rates increase with warming, primarily associated with increasing peak temperatures. In contrast, using a moving-baseline substantially reduces these increases in mid-latitudes, demonstrating that projected heatwave lifecycle changes are sensitive to the evolving climate reference state and may involve changes in climate variability and atmospheric circulation processes. These results highlight the importance of the climate reference framework when interpreting how heatwave lifecycle characteristics may change under continued warming.
items.summary_zh: 极端高温研究主要侧重于静态特征，而热浪的时间演变仍鲜有探讨。本研究利用观测数据（1979–2024年）和CMIP6模拟结果，从热浪的起始率和消退率两个方面，量化了东亚地区热浪生命周期的动态变化。 热浪的增强速度始终快于消退速度，且在高纬度地区这种不对称性更为显著。未来的变化在很大程度上取决于极端事件的定义方式。在固定基准框架下，随着气温升高，热浪的起始速率和消退速率均会增加，这主要与峰值气温的上升有关。 相比之下，采用移动基准框架会显著减弱中纬度地区的这种增长趋势，这表明预测的热浪生命周期变化对不断演变的气候参考状态较为敏感，且可能涉及气候变异性和大气环流过程的变化。这些结果凸显了在解读持续变暖背景下热浪生命周期特征可能发生的变化时，气候参考框架的重要性。
